label: Conservative online observer
title: A suffix learner with explicit abstention and history costs
kind: Implemented instrument with deterministic trace checks
summary: The agreed online arm predicts before observing the successor, refines only a wrong definite prediction, retains history across rebuilds and freezes its model for held-out trajectories.
takeaway: The instrument is implemented; no new CA research evaluation is claimed. Future-equivalence, coarsening, oracle learning and performance predictions remain separate.
